name: 03-late-reader
description: Ring eviction. Lane A writes 20 grains back to back with no pacing; lane B then reads the newest (OK), the oldest of the burst (MXL_ERR_OUT_OF_RANGE_TOO_LATE, evicted) and one past the head (MXL_ERR_OUT_OF_RANGE_TOO_EARLY, not yet written).

A.note: spliced in by jq from flows/video-1080p2997-v210.json
no fill and no delay: this burst exists to move the head, not to be measured

B.note: records the ring depth: if grain_count >= 19 the offset below is too small
control: the newest grain is always readable
the first grain of the burst: expect MXL_ERR_OUT_OF_RANGE_TOO_LATE
